name: @papercusp/data-fetch
description: Generic versioned read-cache: conditional-GET (If-None-Match/304) over @papercusp/kv-persist (IndexedDB) with stale-while-revalidate. The non-grid, non-Zero generalization of 'version every query' — a query's version is a scalar (ETag / count+max hash) instead of a bloom manifest. Hosts useVersionedResource.
